title: Routine open-slot post bypasses paid-promotion secondary-signal gate
original_report: With paid map promotion already detected, one fresh generic public post about routine open slots incorrectly unlocks outreach instead of waiting for an independent secondary signal.
expected: The decision remains observe with reason paid_promotion_requires_secondary_signal.
actual: The decision returned write_now because a single public_signal with fact and source URL was accepted as independent evidence.
environment: Clean ephemeral Docker app container, Python 3.11, pytest installed only inside the disposable container
reproduction: A focused decision-service test combines paid_map_promotion with one fresh public_signal saying 'Горящие окошки...' and verified contact/channel readiness.
failure_signal: Assertion failed: actual write_now, expected observe.
root_cause: _has_secondary_signal_after_paid_promotion excluded social-post kinds but did not recognize a routine availability/open-slot public_signal, so the generic post satisfied the fact-plus-source fallback.
fix_summary: Ignore routine availability/open-slot text only when its evidence kind is public_signal; leave other public signals and composite repeated_open_slots hypotheses unchanged.
why_causal: The new guard runs exactly before the generic fact-plus-source acceptance that produced write_now, while the repeated two-post contract uses pain_signal_hypothesis with signal_combo repeated_open_slots and is unaffected.

reproduction_files.summary: Focused regression fixture approved at Gate 1.

fix_files.summary: Minimal routine-availability public-signal exclusion approved at Gate 2.

limitations: The guard covers routine availability wording represented as public_signal; other weak generic-signal categories require their own explicit contracts.
residual_risks: A materially different synonym for open slots may not match the current Russian-language pattern.
notes: No campaigns were regenerated, persisted, refreshed, queued, or sent. No production database data was changed.
